model: KCMS fan coil controller via KGTW-BAC BACnet gateway
applies_to: RHOSS fan coils and cassettes with the KCMS controller, linked over Modbus RTU to the KGTW-BAC gateway.
summary: KGTW-BAC is a DIN-rail Modbus RTU to BACnet gateway for RHOSS terminal units. With the KCMS_IP or KCMS_MSTP profile each KCMS fan coil shows up as a separate BACnet device with the 20 objects below: temperatures, setpoint, mode and fan speed commands, on/off, economy mode and an alarm code. BACnet IP and BACnet MS/TP are both available.
notes: The guide prints the English IP profile (KCMS_IPeng); the MS/TP profile and the Italian, German and French translations change the object names and descriptions only.
Object names start with IP_FC01_ in the guide's example; the prefix follows the profile and unit set up in the gateway.
The guide marks writable objects W and read-only objects R.
On the KCMS, Modbus RTU is turned on with parameter P54 = 1 and the node ID is parameter P69 (1-207); the line runs at 9600 baud, 8N1.

source.title: KGTW-BAC Bacnet Gateway - Istruzioni per l'uso / Instructions for use

integration.summary: Switch each fan coil with IP_FC01_OnOff (BV 1), set mode (MV 1), fan speed (MV 2) and setpoint (AV 1), then read the control probe, the setpoint in use and the alarm code. IP_FC01_Status (BI 6) shows whether the gateway still talks to the fan coil.
setup: Gateway default IP 192.168.1.24 / 255.255.255.0; it is set up from a web browser (no password at first).
Each fan coil is added as a profile (model, Modbus address, BACnet description) and appears as its own BACnet device; its device instance is the base Instance_nr plus the Modbus address.
The RHOSS side is Modbus RTU on RS485; BACnet MS/TP uses the second RS485 port (station address 1-254 as printed, Max Master 1-127, Info Frames settable).
EDE files can be downloaded from http://<gateway IP>/ede.zip.
gotchas: All fan coils on one Modbus line must share baud rate, parity, data and stop bits; ask RHOSS before putting more than 32 devices on a line.

points.name: IP_FC01_ProbeaBT
points.description: Probe BT, room air (inside control panel)

points.name: IP_FC01_Allarms
points.states: 1=No alarms, 2=Probe ST1 is faulty, 3=Probe ST2 is faulty, 4=Probe ST3 is faulty, 5=Anti-freeze, 6=Overheating, 7=Fan alarm, 8=Remote safety (SIC), 9=General alarm, 10=Faulty EEPROM
